description: Defines the PdfCryptFilters class which manages crypt filters in a PDF security handler, including methods for adding, removing, retrieving, and converting crypt filters, as well as enumerating all filters.

classes.name: PdfCryptFilters
classes.description: Represents and manages the CF dictionary of a PDF security handler, providing methods to manipulate crypt filters.

methods.name: GetCryptFilter
methods.description: Retrieves a crypt filter by name.

methods.name: AddCryptFilter
methods.description: Adds a crypt filter with a specified name.

methods.name: RemoveCryptFilter
methods.description: Removes a crypt filter by name.

methods.name: GetCryptFilters
methods.description: Enumerates all crypt filters as name-filter pairs.

methods.name: GetCryptFiltersAsDictionary
methods.description: Returns all crypt filters as a dictionary.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if there are any crypt filters.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts a PdfItem to a PdfCryptFilter, updating Elements if necessary.
